metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code (Ruby/Rails controller) with HTTP endpoints and MySQL database dependency present. Single deployable service with CRUD operations.
metadata.archetype_justification: Database connections (MySQL 5.1), Create/Update/Read endpoints on Order entity, and user-specific data (orders with card numbers). Classified as stateful-crud.

classification_consistency_check.reason: Score 1.18 yields Not Ready band (< 1.5) but 11 High findings yield Remediation Required tier (2-11 High). The count-based classification requires ≥12 High to reach Not Ready. The divergence reflects that nearly all questions score 1 but the High-severity designation only applies to core questions (11 of 31 findings are High).

top_gaps.title: Secrets Management
top_gaps.gap: Plaintext payment gateway credentials committed to source control in config/payment.yml
top_gaps.impact: Critical security vulnerability — credentials exposed to anyone with repo access and persist in git history

top_gaps.title: Infrastructure as Code Coverage
top_gaps.gap: Zero IaC — all infrastructure manually provisioned
top_gaps.impact: Cannot reproduce environments, no disaster recovery, manual changes error-prone

top_gaps.title: CI/CD Automation
top_gaps.gap: No CI/CD pipeline — deployment via Capistrano 2 with no automation
top_gaps.impact: Manual deployments block rapid iteration and introduce human error

top_gaps.title: Monolith vs Microservices
top_gaps.gap: Tightly-coupled Rails monolith with no module boundaries
top_gaps.impact: Cannot scale independently, no team autonomy, all changes require full deployment

top_gaps.title: Database Engine Version and EOL
top_gaps.gap: MySQL 5.1 is years past end-of-life with known CVEs
top_gaps.impact: Security vulnerabilities, no modern features, increasing migration complexity

findings.title: Managed Compute
findings.description: All compute runs on raw EC2 instances with Mongrel clusters behind Apache. No managed container orchestration or serverless adoption.
findings.gap: No managed compute adoption — 100% raw EC2 with manual scaling and patching.
findings.recommendation: Containerize the application and deploy on Amazon ECS with Fargate or Amazon EKS.

findings.title: Managed Databases
findings.description: MySQL 5.1 runs on a separate EC2 instance — fully self-managed with no automated backups, failover, or patching.
findings.gap: Database is entirely self-managed on EC2 with no managed service adoption.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Amazon RDS for MySQL (8.0+) or Aurora MySQL. Use AWS DMS for migration.

findings.title: Workflow Orchestration
findings.description: The order-payment workflow is entirely hardcoded in the controller with no orchestration, error handling, or retry logic.
findings.gap: No workflow orchestration — business-critical order-payment flow is hardcoded with no error recovery.
findings.recommendation: Introduce AWS Step Functions to orchestrate the order-payment workflow with retry logic and error handling.

findings.title: Async Messaging and Streaming
findings.description: No messaging or streaming infrastructure. Payment gateway call is synchronous within the HTTP request. State changes are not propagated via events.
findings.gap: No messaging where state changes cross service boundaries — tight synchronous coupling.
findings.recommendation: Introduce Amazon SQS or EventBridge for decoupling order state changes from payment processing.

findings.title: Network Security
findings.description: No network security configuration exists in the repository. No VPC definitions, no security groups, no subnet configurations.
findings.gap: No evidence of VPC, private subnets, or security groups.
findings.recommendation: Define infrastructure in IaC with proper VPC architecture: private subnets, least-privilege security groups.

findings.title: API Entry Point
findings.description: No API Gateway, ALB, or CloudFront as entry point. Application served directly by Mongrel behind Apache.
findings.gap: Services exposed with no managed gateway providing authentication, throttling, or request validation.
findings.recommendation: Deploy behind an ALB or introduce API Gateway for throttling, authentication, and request validation.

findings.title: Auto-Scaling
findings.description: No auto-scaling configured. Deployment is to a fixed set of EC2 hosts with no dynamic capacity management.
findings.gap: All capacity is statically provisioned with no ability to respond to traffic changes.
findings.recommendation: Implement auto-scaling groups or ECS service auto-scaling after containerization.

findings.title: Backup and Recovery
findings.description: No backup configuration found for the self-managed MySQL 5.1 database on EC2.
findings.gap: No backup or recovery configuration — data loss risk.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to RDS (includes automated backups) or implement AWS Backup plan with defined retention.

findings.title: Infrastructure as Code Coverage
findings.description: Zero infrastructure as code. No Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, or any IaC files exist. All infrastructure is manually created.
findings.gap: 0% IaC coverage — all infrastructure is manually provisioned (ClickOps).
findings.recommendation: Adopt Terraform or AWS CDK to define all infrastructure as code.

findings.title: CI/CD Automation
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline exists. Deployment is via Capistrano 2 to fixed EC2 hosts with no automated build, test, or deploy stages.
findings.gap: No CI/CD — all deployments are manual scripts with no automated testing or quality gates.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline using AWS CodePipeline + CodeBuild with build, test, and deploy stages.

findings.title: Programming Languages
findings.description: Ruby 1.8.7 (EOL since 2013) with Rails 2.3 (EOL since 2013). Compound regression across language version AND framework.
findings.gap: Language version AND framework are both deeply end-of-life with no modern cloud-native capabilities.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade to Ruby 3.2+ with Rails 7.x, or consider migration to a Tier 1 cloud-native language.

findings.title: Monolith vs Microservices
findings.description: Tightly-coupled monolith with no module boundaries. Business logic, data access, and external integrations all co-located in a single controller.
findings.gap: Tightly-coupled monolith with no clear module boundaries, pervasive shared state.
findings.recommendation: Begin decomposition using Strangler Fig pattern. Extract payment processing as the first independent service.

findings.title: Async vs Sync Communication
findings.description: All communication is synchronous HTTP. Payment gateway call blocks the HTTP request thread with no async patterns.
findings.gap: All communication synchronous HTTP with no async patterns.
findings.recommendation: Introduce async processing for payment operations using SQS or background job framework.

findings.title: Long-Running Process Handling
findings.description: Payment gateway SOAP calls are performed synchronously within the HTTP request with no timeout or async fallback.
findings.gap: All operations synchronous regardless of duration — payment SOAP calls block the user's HTTP request.
findings.recommendation: Move payment processing to an async job. Return order with 'payment pending' status and provide status polling.

findings.title: API Versioning Strategy
findings.description: No API versioning strategy. No /v1/ URL patterns, no version headers, no versioning annotations.
findings.gap: No versioning — breaking changes deployed directly with no backward compatibility.
findings.recommendation: Implement URL-based API versioning (e.g., /api/v1/orders).

findings.title: Service Discovery
findings.description: All service endpoints hard-coded in config/payment.yml. No service registry, no dynamic discovery.
findings.gap: All service endpoints hard-coded in configuration files with no dynamic discovery.
findings.recommendation: Externalize service endpoints using environment variables, then adopt AWS Service Discovery.

findings.title: Unstructured Data Storage
findings.description: Assets served directly from the application with no CDN and no managed object storage (S3).
findings.gap: Data on local file systems served from the app with no CDN or managed object storage.
findings.recommendation: Migrate static assets to Amazon S3 with CloudFront CDN.

findings.title: Unified Data Access Layer
findings.description: Database queries scattered directly in controllers using find_by_sql with raw SQL. No repository pattern or centralized data access.
findings.gap: Database imports and queries scattered in controllers with no unified data access pattern.
findings.recommendation: Introduce proper ActiveRecord scopes and model methods. Centralize data access in a repository layer.

findings.title: Database Engine Version and EOL
findings.description: MySQL 5.1 is documented as the database engine. MySQL 5.1 reached end-of-life in December 2013 — over a decade past EOL.
findings.gap: Database engine is years past end-of-life with no security patches and known vulnerabilities.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade to MySQL 8.0+ or Aurora MySQL 3.x as part of managed database migration.

findings.title: Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest configured for the MySQL database on EC2 or any other data store.
findings.gap: No encryption at rest configured on any data store.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to RDS with encryption enabled (KMS). Enable EBS encryption on EC2-hosted MySQL volume.

findings.title: API Authentication
findings.description: No API authentication on endpoints. Controller notes 'No before_filter auth on some actions (legacy oversight)'.
findings.gap: No API authentication — endpoints are open with no per-request auth.
findings.recommendation: Implement authentication middleware. Adopt OAuth2/JWT for token-based authentication.

findings.title: Centralized Identity Integration
findings.description: Application manages its own authentication with cookie-based sessions. No centralized IdP integration.
findings.gap: Application manages its own authentication entirely with no external IdP integration.
findings.recommendation: Integrate with Amazon Cognito or an external IdP for centralized identity management.

findings.title: Secrets Management
findings.description: Plaintext credentials committed to source control. config/payment.yml contains merchant_id and api_password in plain text.
findings.gap: Plaintext credentials in source control — critical security vulnerability.
findings.recommendation: Immediately rotate all exposed credentials. Migrate secrets to AWS Secrets Manager with automated rotation.

findings.title: Compute Hardening and Patching
findings.description: No patching strategy, vulnerability scanning, or compute hardening. Ruby 1.8.7 and Rails 2.3 have numerous known unpatched CVEs.
findings.gap: No patching strategy — runtime has known unpatched CVEs with no vulnerability scanning.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated patching and vulnerability scanning (AWS Inspector, Dependabot).

findings.title: Application Security Pipeline
findings.description: No security scanning tools configured. No SAST, no DAST, no dependency scanning. No CI/CD pipeline exists.
findings.gap: No security scanning tools — no Dependabot, no SAST, no container scanning.
findings.recommendation: Add Dependabot for dependency scanning. Integrate SAST (Brakeman for Ruby) into CI/CD pipeline.

findings.title: Distributed Tracing
findings.description: No distributed tracing instrumented. No X-Ray, no OpenTelemetry, no trace ID propagation.
findings.gap: No distributed tracing — cannot trace requests across service boundaries.
findings.recommendation: Instrument with AWS X-Ray or OpenTelemetry SDK.

findings.title: SLO Definitions
findings.description: No SLOs defined. No CloudWatch alarms, no error budget tracking, no formal service level definitions.
findings.gap: No SLOs — no formal definition of acceptable service levels.
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs for critical user journeys (order placement success rate, page load latency).

findings.title: Business Metrics
findings.description: No custom metrics published. No business outcome metrics tracked.
findings.gap: No custom metrics — only default infrastructure metrics with no business outcome visibility.
findings.recommendation: Publish custom CloudWatch metrics for business outcomes: order creation rate, payment success/failure rate.

findings.title: Anomaly Detection and Alerting
findings.description: No alerting or anomaly detection configured. No CloudWatch alarms, no incident notification.
findings.gap: No alerting configured — degradation or outages would go undetected.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch alarms for error rates and latency. Add anomaly detection for critical metrics.

findings.title: Integration Testing
findings.description: No functional automated tests. Stale Test::Unit suite that no longer runs. No integration tests, no API tests.
findings.gap: No integration tests — only a stale, non-functional test suite exists.
findings.recommendation: Implement integration test suite covering critical workflows. Add to CI pipeline.

findings.title: Observability Ownership
findings.description: No observability ownership defined. No per-service dashboards, no alarms with named owners.
findings.gap: No observability ownership — monitoring is reactive and fragmented.
findings.recommendation: Define observability ownership with per-service dashboards and alarms.
